'''Ordnance and Supply''', also known as '''OaS''', was a part of the command of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was headed by the [[Chief of Ordnance and Supply]]. Ordnance and Supply was charged with securing equipment, weapons, and [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] for the [[Alliance Forces]]. Individual [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Commands]] were expected to procure their own food and small arms to supply their local forces, leaving Ordnance and Supply free to concentrate their efforts on attaining hard to obtain items necessary for the war effort, such as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and high-grade [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]], to keep the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] supplied.<ref name="RASB" />

Ordnance and Supply worked in concert with [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]] to transport the materials throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; Ordnance and Supply had no direct [[Transport/Legends|transport]] capabilities, and relied on the Support Services fleet. Ordnance and Supply worked closely with their civilian counterpart, the [[Ministry of Supply]], in the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]].<ref name="RASB" />

Part of Ordnance and Supply's remit was to engage in weapons and vehicle research and development, attempting to upgrade and update the Alliance's weapons and equipment.<ref name="RASB" />

A warning issued by Ordnance and Supply Command shortly after the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brigia]] about a shortage of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] led to a search operation and the recovery of the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Ars Opus]]'' which was carrying [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Supreme Allied Commanders|Supreme Commander]] of Ordnance and Supply was [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]].<ref name="J2" />
